Chapter 7145: Beat The Dogs First

Chapter 7145: Beat The Dogs First

Everyone was surprised to see an ordinary man daring to interfere, akin to a bug yelling at a true dragon.

However, Apex and the others rejoiced at his sight.

“Sir!” They shouted.

Those in Divine Firmaments had no idea since their world had been isolated from Heavenrealm.

“The odds don’t look great.” Stone Immortal worried.

“Not necessarily.” The monarch kept his mouth shut.

Five great divine beasts gazed intensely at Li Qiye. Just their eyes alone could melt a minor world.

“Who are you?” Kun Peng asked.

“Just a passerby who happens to be here right now.” Li Qiye stretched and said.

They didn’t buy it and knew something was off about this mortal.

“You have no business here.” Gluttonous said.

“I didn’t want to get involved but since you all said that no one was leaving Divine Firmament, I was dragged into this mess. So let me ask, can I leave or not?” Li Qiye said.

The divine beasts exchanged glances, aware of Li Qiye being a hidden master.

“We will be magnanimous and make an exception for you.” Kun Peng took a deep breath and said.

No one expected this answer because the divine beasts have proven themselves to be heartless. They were willing to kill their world, let alone a stranger.

“Wrong answer.” Li Qiye waved and smiled: “I come and leave when I want, no matter where I am. I don’t need anyone’s permission or magnanimity...”

“Are you leaving or not?!” Lunar Wolf interrupted him.

“Your attitude makes me even less inclined to leave. I suppose I have enough time to do a bit of cleaning here.” Li Qiye said.

“Cleaning what?” Qilin uttered coldly.

“Just some weeds and pests.” Li Qiye explained: “It’s like a pond with a big fish wanting to eat all the smaller ones. In that case, I have to take care of the big fish.”

“You speak as if you’re the master of the pond.” Gluttonous said.

“That would be an understatement.” Li Qiye smiled.

“Do you think you can act as the high heaven?” Kun Peng spoke menacingly.

“The high heaven cannot eradicate you all without descending, but as for me, it is as simple as crushing bedbugs. How do you think I compare to the high heaven now?” Li Qiye asked.

“Strong words.” Death Serpent didn’t believe him.

Although some were labeled equal to the high heaven in history, was this actually the case? If it were true, they would have killed the high heaven and taken its place.

“Let us see if you can do it.” Lunar Wolf channeled his power and sent it toward Li Qiye.

Alas, it appeared as harmless as a gust of wind.

“Fine, have to beat the dogs first before the owner appears.” Li Qiye patted the dust off his robe.

As the divine beasts were furious, a voice from the sea of wisdom commanded: “Retreat.”

This was the same voice that had put an end to Worldbearer Tortoise. The divine beasts exchanged glances, not expecting to hear this command.

“Bam!” The maelstrom sucked in Skykiller Palace. The beasts saw this and also fled.

Li Qiye only watched with a smile, not bothering to give chase.

“Bang!” The maelstrom disappeared and the sea solidified. Surging waves became solid masses, still with wavy patterns on the surface.

This stunned Divine Firmament; none could speak on this sudden development.
